summary: Phase 0B section 9 forbids beginning formal labeling until reviewer availability is identified. No reviewer is identified. Labeling has therefore not begun.

roles.responsibility: Independent first label of every governed case across the seven dual-review fields.
roles.independenceRequirement: Must not see the secondary reviewer's labels before submitting.

roles.responsibility: Independent second label, blind to the primary.
roles.independenceRequirement: Must not see the primary reviewer's labels before submitting. May not be the same person as the primary.

roles.responsibility: Resolves every field where the two reviewers disagree, and records the reason.
roles.independenceRequirement: May also hold ONE reviewer role, provided both initial labels were produced independently and blind.

identityPolicy.rule: Reviewer identities are referenced here by role and by an authorization reference, and are NEVER written into individual case records.
identityPolicy.enforcement: tools/scanner-evaluation/lib/datasetValidate.js rejects a case record containing a reviewer name, email or id, and the existing privacy-surface check rejects any email-shaped string anywhere in a manifest.

whyAiLabelingIsNotASubstitute.position: An AI agent labeling the same image twice produces one labeler run twice. It is not two independent reviews, and an inter-reviewer agreement statistic computed from it would be fabricated.
whyAiLabelingIsNotASubstitute.whatWasProducedInstead: Per-fixture visual observations were recorded in fixtures-inventory v0.2.0 as machine-assisted DRAFT primary observations, explicitly attributed as such. They are not reviewer labels, they carry reviewStatus draft, and they are not admissible to a frozen dataset.
whyAiLabelingIsNotASubstitute.whatUnblocksThis: The owner assigning a primary reviewer, an independent secondary reviewer, and an adjudicator.

blockedDeliverables: two independent reviews of all 75 cases
calibration batch execution and qualification threshold sign-off
